corrections.reason: Continuing from the previous page ('ይህች ልጁም'), the commentary says 'ልጇም እንደሁነች አልታወቀም' (whether she was his daughter or her daughter was not known). Visually, ጇ was misread as ቋ and feminine ች was misread as ት.
The Amharic gerundive phrase is 'እያልክ መሾምህ' with 6th-order ክ, clearly visible on the page.
In the context of 'ከዳኛ ፊት መማታት አይገባም', the commentary explains 'ምንም ቢሆን ዳኛ ብሏልና' (for whatever may be, Scripture called him a judge). Visually, faded ዳኛ was transposed/misread as ጎዳ.
